findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered with Spanish subjunctive muera; person and number stay, mood is smoothing.
Common noun האדם (article + Ncmsa, H120) is left as untranslated adam instead of a Spanish common noun.
Hithpael imperfect 3ms of H2398 is rendered se pecará, reflexive of the qal ‘sin’ sense; that stem’s force is purify oneself, not commit sin.
Common noun משכן (Ncmsc, H4908) is left as untranslated mishkán instead of a Spanish common noun.
את marks משכן as object of piel perfect 3ms טמא (the toucher defiles it). el mishkán … impureció reads as the dwelling doing the defiling.
Common noun נדה (Ncfsa, H5079) is left as untranslated nidá instead of a Spanish common noun.
Qal perfect 3ms active זרק (someone did not throw the waters) is rendered feminine plural passive fueron echadas, with the waters as subject.

notes: Jehová, Israel, alma twice, cortada with aquella, and the verbless עוד clause match the tokens.
